mapper.select: SELECT D.ID, D.REC_VER, D.PARENT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME AS TITLE FROM sys_dept D ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
mapper.sql: select DISTINCT D.ID, D.CREATOR, D.MODIFIER, D.LOGIC_DEL, D.REC_VER, D.PARENT_ID, D.ANCESTORS, D.DEPT_NAME, D.ORDER_NUM, D.LEADER, D.TEL_NO, D.EMAIL, D.DEPT_STATUS, D.REMARK, D.REC_VER from sys_dept D left join sys_user U on U.DEPT_ID = D.ID
